people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A place associated with the prophets Elijah and Elisha.

translations.web: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
translations.bsb: Shortly before the LORD took Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jehovah would take up Elijah by a whirlwind into heaven, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
